## Notes

Owen Blanton Burrow, died March 3, 1998 at age 89. Birthdate November 21, 1908 in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. Died in Methodist Hospital, South Lake Campus, Merrillville, Lake County, IN. Widowed, self-employed.
Address 3213 E. 37th Avenue, Lake Station, Lake County, IN.
Father: Samuel Burrow; mother Lenora Blanton.
